def order(api, customer_id, *items):
    return api.orders.handle_create({"customer_id": customer_id,
                                     "items": [{"sku": s, "quantity": q} for s, q in items]})


def test_order_history_unknown_customer_is_404(shop):
    response = shop.insights.handle_order_history("nobody")
    assert response.status == 404
    assert response.body == {"error": "customer not found"}


def test_order_history_empty_for_customer_without_orders(shop):
    response = shop.insights.handle_order_history("c1")
    assert response.status == 200
    assert response.body == {"customer_id": "c1", "orders": []}


def test_order_history_is_newest_first(shop):
    first = order(shop, "c1", ("PEN", 1)).body["order_id"]
    second = order(shop, "c1", ("BOOK", 1)).body["order_id"]
    third = order(shop, "c1", ("LAMP", 1)).body["order_id"]
    response = shop.insights.handle_order_history("c1")
    assert response.status == 200
    assert [o["order_id"] for o in response.body["orders"]] == [third, second, first]


def test_order_history_total_matches_order_summary_including_discount(shop):
    # c2 is gold: 4 * 2500 = 10000 subtotal qualifies, 15% off -> 8500.
    created = order(shop, "c2", ("BOOK", 4)).body["order_id"]
    summary = shop.orders.handle_get(created).body
    history = shop.insights.handle_order_history("c2").body["orders"]
    assert history == [{"order_id": created, "status": "placed",
                        "total_cents": summary["total_cents"]}]
    assert history[0]["total_cents"] == 8_500


def test_order_history_includes_cancelled_orders_with_status(shop):
    kept = order(shop, "c1", ("PEN", 2)).body["order_id"]
    cancelled = order(shop, "c1", ("PEN", 3)).body["order_id"]
    shop.orders.handle_cancel(cancelled)
    orders = shop.insights.handle_order_history("c1").body["orders"]
    assert orders == [
        {"order_id": cancelled, "status": "cancelled", "total_cents": 900},
        {"order_id": kept, "status": "placed", "total_cents": 600},
    ]


def test_insights_is_exposed_on_api(api):
    from orders.controllers.customer_insights import CustomerInsightsController
    assert isinstance(api.insights, CustomerInsightsController)

- **`src/orders/application/order_service.py`**: new `OrderService.order_history(customer_id)`.
